about: Revocation evidence just outside the freshness bound: 25 hours old at the evaluation instant, one hour past the 24-hour bound.
why: Evaluated at 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z; the revocation check is 90000 seconds old against an 86400-second bound. Stale revocation evidence is could-not-determine (hold), never pass. Loose bound test: raising the bound to 90000 seconds makes this case pass, so the selftest detects a bound that was widened without justification.
